scripts.build: npm run build:shared && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:functions: npm run build:shared && npm run build --prefix functions
scripts.predeploy:check: npm run verify:production && npm run build:functions && npm run build
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting --project sales-presentation-portal
scripts.deploy:all: npm run predeploy:check && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,storage,functions,hosting --project sales-presentation-portal
